request:
Please fact-check this launch note against the supplied materials and tell me what needs correcting.

VelaDesk launch note
In the May 2026 pilot, 192 of 200 customer imports completed without manual intervention [pilot-summary]. All VelaDesk plans include 24/7 live telephone support.

sources.title: VelaDesk May 2026 pilot summary
sources.content: Pilot period: May 1–31, 2026. Customer imports attempted: 200. Imports completed without manual intervention: 192. Imports requiring manual intervention: 8.

sources.title: VelaDesk support plan guide, effective June 1, 2026
sources.content: Basic: email support, Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 Pacific. Telephone support is not included. Plus: email support and scheduled telephone callbacks, Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 Pacific. Business: email support and live telephone support 24 hours a day, seven days a week. These are the complete support entitlements for the three plans.

request:
I need a brief status report on the board-update fact check from the reviewer handoff below. Summarize the work so far without continuing the audit.

Draft board update
Project Alder migrated 42 customer workspaces in June 2026 [migration-log]. Median support resolution time fell from 18 hours in May to 12 hours in June 2026 [support-report].

sources.title: Board-update fact-check handoff
sources.content: Agreed review scope: both factual claims in the draft board update. Work completed: checked the migration count against the June migration log; the log records 42 completed customer-workspace migrations. Work stopped when the reviewer was called into a production incident. The reviewer had not opened the support report or examined the claim about median support resolution time. The support report is available in the board folder. No result for that claim has been recorded.

sources.title: Project Alder June 2026 migration summary
sources.content: Reporting period: June 1–30, 2026. Customer workspaces with completed migrations during the period: 42. This total excludes test workspaces and migrations still in progress.
